name: cap-prompt
note: The owner's bug report of 26 November 2026, on ia-40's session fixture: jumble.cap.name without a number opens the cap prompt, every cap in cap-id order with its class and N_c and nothing highlighted. Typing 15 narrows it to 15 and 150 to 159, two Downs highlight cap 150 and Enter names it; the prompt opens again and a click on cap 7's row names cap 7; Escape closes it the third time with cap 7 still named. The last wait keeps the window open for the foreground check.
